title: CSS Flexbox vs Grid, Explained Simply
intro: Both are for layout, but they solve different problems. Knowing which to reach for saves a lot of frustration.

slides.heading: Flexbox
slides.subtitle: Layout in one direction: a row or a column.
points: Add display: flex to the parent
justify-content aligns along the main axis
align-items aligns along the cross axis

slides.heading: Grid
slides.subtitle: Layout in two directions: rows and columns.
points: Add display: grid to the parent

slides.heading: When to use which
slides.subtitle: A simple rule of thumb.
points: Items in a single line? Use Flexbox
Rows and columns together? Use Grid
examples: Grid for the page, Flexbox inside each card
